blocks.text: Biogeography (paudon aur janwaron ki duniya mein jughrafiyai taqseem, yaani kaun kahan paya jata hai, ka mutala) dikhati hai ke duniya ke mukhtalif hisson ke jandaron ki evolution ki apni alag tareekh hai. Maslan:

items: Milte julte jandaron ke group aisi jaghon par reh sakte hain jo bari rukawaton (barriers, jaise samandar) se alag hain. Wazeh mushabihat (similarities) mushtarka buzurg (common ancestor) ki taraf ishara karti hai, jabke wazeh farq laakhon saal ke alag alag evolution ka nateeja hain. Maslan African sher (lion) America ke mountain lion se bohat milta hai. Un ki mushabihat mushtarka buzurg batati hai, aur un ke farq laakhon saal ke alag evolution ka nateeja hain.

Jughrafiyai rukawaton se alag hue jandar milte julte mahol ke bawajood aksar bohat mukhtalif hote hain. Maslan Australia aur Tasmania ke bohat se janwar duniya ke kisi bhi aur hisse ke janwaron se bohat mukhtalif hain. Wahan kangaroo ki bohat si species bare herbivores (ghaas aur patte khane wale janwar) hain.

Jazeeron (islands) par aksar species kam hoti hain lekin munfarid (unique, jo kahin aur na milen) hoti hain. Wajah yeh hai ke chand jandar jazeere par pohanch kar aabad hue (colonization) aur phir wahan alag se evolve hue.

blocks.alt: Duniya ka naqsha jis ke beech Bahr-e-Kahil (Pacific) hai aur Equator ki lakeer. African lion ka ilaqa gehra surkh: Sahara ke junoob mein Africa aur mashriqi Africa. Mountain lion ka ilaqa gehra neela: maghribi North America, Central America aur zyada tar South America. Oopar baayen 'African lion' aur daayen 'Mountain lion' ki tasweerein, teeron ke saath apne ilaqon ki taraf.

blocks.title: Sheron ke baare mein
blocks.text: America ka mountain lion (puma ya cougar) African sher se mukhtalif genus ka hai; dono billi khandan ke hain, aur un ki mushtarka khasiyatein billi khandan ke mushtarka buzurg se aayi hain.

blocks.prompt: Jazeeron par aksar munfarid (unique) species kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke sirf chand jandar jazeere tak pohanch kar wahan aabad hote hain aur phir baqi duniya se alag reh kar evolve hote hain, is liye un ki nasl aisi species ban jati hai jo kahin aur nahin milti.

items: Door door milte julte groups: mushabihat = mushtarka buzurg; farq = laakhon saal ka alag evolution (African lion aur mountain lion).
Rukawaton se alag ilaqe (Australia, Tasmania): milta julta mahol, lekin bohat mukhtalif janwar (kangaroo).
